title: Speiro Verification 0.2.1 Partial Pilot Candidate
description: Incomplete local development draft for independent review; not an approved publication.

resource.name: AffectedUnitReference
resource.description: Flag reference to an affected Observation, repeatable for multiple windows. Unit-profile-specific targeting remains pending; the enforced target type is Observation.

resource.name: Available Pilot Authorization Window
resource.description: Date-window comparison only; an authorization number is included only when supported. No service lines, unit or payment comparison. No covering authorization can truthfully have no number or window.

resource.name: Blocking
resource.description: True means this finding reflects a specific capture restriction imposed by immutable first-Start consent permissions. Identify the restricted purpose or modality in the finding/evidence. It does not block treatment, Start, End, review, report finalization, delivery, billing or payment. Missing attestation documentation alone and later consent changes do not establish a restriction for the running session. Otherwise-conformant reports may include true. Historical missing bindings are not proof of restriction; production mapping is planned future work.

resource.name: CanonicalRecordHash
resource.description: SHA-256 of Speiro's versioned canonical record input, on finalization Provenance. Required once by the finalization profile as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. This lexical constraint does not compute the digest or enforce document-wide single ownership.

resource.name: Consent parent illustration: missing-code-only
resource.description: Terminology illustration only: required consent evidence is genuinely absent at first Start. No capture facts or report conformance are asserted; no blocking value is selected from the code alone. This is not a historical-unknown representation or a production finding. Review severity highlights this finding for human attention only; it creates no treatment or report hold, acknowledgement workflow, or payer decision. Capture restriction requires independent first-Start facts.

resource.name: Consent parent illustration: missing-location
resource.description: Separate location illustration. At first Start, required location_collection evidence is literally absent, independently established. Synthetic fact: location_collection, required_missing, literal absence, source F3, binding B3 v1, evidence E3, record R1, Start S1, subject A. Stored Start permissions independently restrict location collection. Documentary labels do not define evidence reference targets. Review severity highlights this finding for human attention only; it creates no treatment or report hold, acknowledgement workflow, or payer decision. Capture restriction requires independent first-Start facts. Record scope concerns this selected session record only; it does not assert missing evidence for every modality or window. The subject remains the client; each contributing purpose, reason and evidence label remains distinct. Later consent changes do not rewrite these first-Start facts.

resource.name: Consent parent illustration: missing-wearable
resource.description: Illustrative compatible wearable group only. At first Start, required wearable_use and on_device_camera_capture evidence is literally absent; absence is independently established, not inferred from required_missing. Both purposes share record R1, Start S1, subject A and the same review severity and record scope. Original synthetic facts: wearable_use, required_missing, literal absence, source F1, binding B1 v1, evidence E1; on_device_camera_capture, required_missing, literal absence, source F2, binding B2 v1, evidence E2. Stored Start permissions independently restrict wearable capture. Labels are documentary synthetic references, not approved identifier namespaces. Review severity highlights this finding for human attention only; it creates no treatment or report hold, acknowledgement workflow, or payer decision. Capture restriction requires independent first-Start facts. Record scope concerns this selected session record only; it does not assert missing evidence for every modality or window. The subject remains the client; each contributing purpose, reason and evidence label remains distinct. Later consent changes do not rewrite these first-Start facts.

resource.name: Consent parent illustration: withdrawn-wearable
resource.description: Separate withdrawn wearable illustration, never merged with missing. Immutable first-Start facts establish withdrawal effective before Start. Synthetic fact: wearable_use, required_withdrawn, withdrawal before Start, source F4, binding B4 v1, evidence E4, record R1, Start S1, subject A. Stored Start permissions independently restrict wearable capture. No later-withdrawal finding or running-session cutoff is asserted. Review severity highlights this finding for human attention only; it creates no treatment or report hold, acknowledgement workflow, or payer decision. Capture restriction requires independent first-Start facts. Record scope concerns this selected session record only; it does not assert missing evidence for every modality or window. The subject remains the client; each contributing purpose, reason and evidence label remains distinct. Later consent changes do not rewrite these first-Start facts.

resource.name: EvidenceReference
resource.description: Repeatable supporting-evidence Reference on Flag or Observation. Reference targets and raw-payload exclusion are governance concerns not fully constrained here.

resource.name: EvidenceTier
resource.description: Composition evidence tier, required once by the record-header profile, with a required SpeiroEvidenceTierVS code. No payment conclusion.

resource.name: FlagScope
resource.description: Flag scope, required once by SpeiroVerificationFlag and bound to SpeiroFlagScopeVS. Identifies the factual context affected. Record scope is approved for precise consent_missing and consent_withdrawn findings reporting immutable first-Start capture restrictions; it does not assert gaps in every modality or window.

resource.name: FlagSeverity
resource.description: Flag factual severity, required once by SpeiroVerificationFlag and bound to SpeiroFlagSeverityVS. Independent of blocking. Review is approved for the precise consent_missing and consent_withdrawn meanings only; other condition mappings remain pending.

resource.name: Non-consent Exception Flag
resource.description: Governed sibling for a supported selected-record exception. No capture-blocking assertion, outcome recalculation, treatment or payment consequence. Source truth and complete associations require application checks.

resource.name: Non-consent Exception Reasons
resource.description: Only the approved meanings; no automatic failed-check mapping.

resource.name: Non-consent Exception Reasons
resource.description: Qualified meanings for independently supported selected-record exceptions, never inferred solely from a failed or unavailable check.

resource.name: Pilot Location Result
resource.description: Four factual location categories retaining a supported original reason. Consent-not-collected is distinct and does not claim this profile. No capture-blocking assertion is inferred.

resource.name: Signing Key ID
resource.description: Provenance signing-key identifier string for signing lineage, not private key bytes. Secret exclusion is a governance requirement not enforced by a string constraint.

resource.name: Speiro ABA Verification Composition
resource.description: Partial development profile; incomplete. Record header with required factual evidence tier and verification outcome. Payer disposition is outside the governed purpose; this partial profile does not prohibit every possible payload.

resource.name: Speiro Canonical Check Fact ValueSet
resource.description: The four currently traced canonical check kinds only.

resource.name: Speiro Canonical Evidence Check Observation
resource.description: Supported canonical check snapshot only. Source scope and unavailable facts stay visible; no automatic Flag or blocking mapping.

resource.name: Speiro Client Comparison Result Observation
resource.description: Narrow client result profile. Preserves precise source status, its reported or derived basis, and supported reasons without claiming calibrated identity or presence from an unavailable comparison.

resource.name: Speiro Coarse Pilot Location
resource.description: Supported controlled facility alias/coarse setting only, no address or coordinates; free-text privacy and source approval require separate checks.

resource.name: Speiro Consent Contribution Assembly Provenance
resource.description: Assembly provenance: one contribution, actual assembly agent and recording time, generic immutable input identifiers. No claim of consent evaluation, evidence access, source truth or finalization hash ownership.

resource.name: Speiro Consent Evidence Fact
resource.description: Observable consent-context facts; codes do not themselves express permission outcomes.

resource.name: Speiro Consent Metadata Gap
resource.description: A specific unavailable metadata fact or incomplete assembly-input association for a selected consent contribution. Does not establish consent absence, withdrawal, permission, capture blocking, report outcome, treatment/payment consequences or an operational hold.

resource.name: Speiro Consent Metadata Gap Flag
resource.description: One specific metadata gap for one supported consent contribution in the selected report. Independent of consent-parent findings, capture blocking and overall report outcome. No gap-resolution or acknowledgement hold. Definition-level contract; source truth, accounting and production mapping require separate checks.

resource.name: Speiro Consent Metadata Gap ValueSet
resource.description: The five consent contribution metadata-gap meanings, separate from consent-parent and permission-uncertainty meanings.

resource.name: Speiro Consent Permission Uncertainty Observation
resource.description: Unavailable first-Start capture permission; does not establish permission, restriction, missing consent or withdrawal.

resource.name: Speiro Evidence Check Outcome
resource.description: lossless canonical check outcomes; unavailable is not failed and not-required is not passed.

resource.name: Speiro Evidence Check Outcome ValueSet
resource.description: Exact proposed canonical check outcomes.

resource.name: Speiro Identity Fact
resource.description: Governed observable identity facts and source metadata, not numeric confidence or biometric scores.

resource.name: Speiro Opaque Pilot Session
resource.description: Session spine with approved namespace and proposed opaque report-lineage token policy; not a report-version identity or raw backend UUID.

resource.name: Speiro Opaque Pilot Subject
resource.description: Opaque subject identity for the proposed lineage scope only; no payer identifier or demographic disclosure authorized by this profile.

resource.name: Speiro Pilot Context Fact
resource.description: minimum-necessary context facts; no payer, permission or capability-to-result inference.

resource.name: Speiro Provider Comparison Result Observation
resource.description: Narrow provider result profile. Supported categorical outcome and recorded source/version metadata only; no score band or numeric confidence. Override remains separate, simulation cannot assert a real match, and production mapping is excluded.

resource.name: Speiro Provider Identity Outcome ValueSet
resource.description: Provider comparison outcomes only. Client-only calibration and usable-face outcomes are excluded; override and simulation cannot establish a real match.

resource.name: Speiro Service Segment Encounter
resource.description: Selected source service segment, under its session; status/class must be supported independently, not invented from a service code.

resource.name: Speiro Unavailable Authorization Observation
resource.description: Authorization unavailable in this canonical projection; not denial, missing consent or a check at generated_at.

resource.name: Speiro Unit and Check Fact

resource.name: Speiro Unit Verification Observation

resource.name: Speiro Verification Finalization Provenance
resource.description: Partial development profile; incomplete. Applies only to the record-finalization event after finalization. Other events must not claim hash ownership under governance; single-owner enforcement across the document remains pending.

resource.name: Speiro Verification Flag
resource.description: Partial development profile; incomplete. Factual review condition. Blocking identifies a first-Start consent capture restriction, independently of severity; true does not prevent an otherwise-conformant report. Consent reason coding and production mapping remain pending. Raw evidence is outside the governed purpose; this partial profile does not enforce payload exclusion.
